description: Kerminal-only pruning: init defaults to Kerminal without platform selection; channel runtime, ablate/restore, and platforms commands removed.
changelog: **Kerminal-only focus release.** `trellis init` now configures Kerminal directly — no platform-selection prompt, no `--kerminal` flag required. Removed: `trellis channel` (multi-agent runtime dependent on external claude/codex CLIs), `trellis ablate`/`restore` (upstream demo feature — `uninstall` remains), and `trellis platforms` (single-platform distribution). Kerminal's built-in sub-agent dispatch (trellis-implement/check/research skills) is unaffected. ~27k lines removed.
